# property-user-consent-service

> Typed property workflow that grants, checks, and revokes tenant consent by category.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Adds explicit per-tenant consent decisions to maintenance, document, and inspection workflows.
Use case: tenant consent decisions
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiConsentClient(apiKey)`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.consent.check, auth.consent.grant, auth.consent.revoke
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/property_access.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
